name: GO Classes CS/DA Test Series 2026 | Engineering Mathematics | Topic Wise Test 2

question.text: A search committee is formed to find a new software engineer. The committee will select three candidates to be interviewed. If $9$ applicants apply for the job, how many ways are there to select a subset of three candidates to interview?
Let $S$ be the set of all strings of length $10$ over the alphabet $\{a, b, c\}$. How many strings from $S$ have exactly $2$ $a$'s?
Let $S$ be the set of all strings of length $10$ over the alphabet $\{a, b, c\}$. How many strings from $S$ have exactly $2$ $a$'s and exactly $3$ $b$'s?

  4. ${ }_{8} C_{0} \times{ }_{8} C_{1} \times{ }_{8} C_{2} \times{ }_{8} C_{3}$
